**DigitalT3 – AI-Enabled Learning Management System (LMS)**

DigitalT3 is an AI software services and consulting firm. This Learning Management System (LMS) is a strategic internal platform designed to embed training, evaluation, and readiness scoring into DigitalT3’s delivery lifecycle. The platform leverages AI to enhance learning, automate evaluation, and provide actionable insights for talent development and project readiness. It is built to be secure, scalable, GDPR-ready, and cloud-native, aligning with modern enterprise requirements.
container_info.reasoning: The container is explicitly named LMSDatabase(MongoDB) and container type is 'database'. The Dockerfile summary lists mongodb-org preinstalled, indicating this container's role is a MongoDB database server for the DigitalT3 LMS. The application description describes an AI-enabled LMS but does not specify a particular app framework; given the container context, the correct platform classification is database and the appropriate 'framework' is the database engine itself (MongoDB).
requirements: MongoDB server runtime (mongod) installed and runnable
Data directory with correct permissions (e.g., /data/db) and sufficient disk space
Minimal mongod configuration file (bindIp adjusted for container networking, no production tuning)
Open port for MongoDB (default 27017) exposed internally to other containers
Basic user creation script for a development user (createUser with readWrite on dev database) executed at container start
Small init script to restore a minimal dev dataset if required (optional, only for basic functionality)
Healthcheck command (e.g., mongo --eval 'db.runCommand({ping:1})') for container orchestration
Lightweight monitoring/logging: write logs to stdout/stderr (no enterprise monitoring agents)
Non-root user to run mongod in container (recommended for headless operation)
No production backup/replication configuration — keep single-node, development-only setup

steps.name: environment: prepare data dir, non-root user, disk & log validations, workspace config
steps.description: Prepare /data/db with secure ownership, create a non-root system user 'mongodev' with its own group, verify available disk space for /data (fail if below threshold), validate that /proc/1/fd/1 is writable by mongod and otherwise create a workspace-local log file symlinked to stdout, back up any system mongod config, best-effort detect a running system mongod (do not forcibly kill services) and emit clear guidance if port 27017 is in use. Writes a minimal workspace-local mongod.conf binding to 0.0.0.0 without enabling auth (bootstrap mode). All artifacts are placed under the workspace path. This step intentionally fails fast on insufficient disk to avoid partial automation runs.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/lms_dt3-307785-309186/LMSDatabase(MongoDB)"
MIN_KB=51200
sudo mkdir -p /data/db && sudo chmod 700 /data/db
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"/config "$WORKSPACE"/logs
# disk free check
AVAIL_KB=$(df --output=avail -k /data | tail -n1 || echo 0)
if [ "${AVAIL_KB:-0}" -lt "$MIN_KB" ]; then echo "ERROR: insufficient disk space on /data ($AVAIL_KB KB)" > "$WORKSPACE"/logs/env-error.log && exit 14; fi
# create non-root user if missing
if ! id -u mongodev >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo useradd --system --user-group --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin mongodev; fi
sudo chown -R mongodev:mongodev /data/db
# check /proc/1/fd/1 writability, fallback to workspace log file symlinked to stdout
if [ -w /proc/1/fd/1 ] 2>/dev/null; then LOG_PATH="/proc/1/fd/1"; else sudo touch "$WORKSPACE"/logs/mongod.log && sudo chown mongodev:mongodev "$WORKSPACE"/logs/mongod.log && LOG_PATH="$WORKSPACE"/logs/mongod.log; fi
# backup system config if present
if [ -f /etc/mongod.conf ]; then sudo cp /etc/mongod.conf "/etc/mongod.conf.bak.$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"; fi
# detect running mongod and fail with guidance (do not forcibly stop system services)
if ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":27017" || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":27017"; then echo "ERROR: port 27017 in use; stop existing mongod or free port before running scripts" > "$WORKSPACE"/logs/env-error.log && exit 13; fi
# write workspace-local mongod config (no auth for bootstrap)
cat > "$WORKSPACE"/config/mongod.conf <<EOF
storage:
  dbPath: /data/db
systemLog:
  destination: file
  path: ${LOG_PATH}
  logAppend: true
net:
  bindIp: 0.0.0.0
  port: 27017
processManagement:
  fork: false
EOF
sudo chmod 644 "$WORKSPACE"/config/mongod.conf
sudo chown -R "$(id -un)":"$(id -gn)" "$WORKSPACE"/config "$WORKSPACE"/logs || true
exit 0

set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/lms_dt3-307785-309186/LMSDatabase(MongoDB)"
MIN_KB=51200
LOG_DIR="$WORKSPACE/logs"
CONF_DIR="$WORKSPACE/config"
mkdir -p "$CONF_DIR" "$LOG_DIR"
# ensure data dir
sudo mkdir -p /data/db && sudo chmod 700 /data/db
# disk free check (fail fast)
AVAIL_KB=$(df --output=avail -k /data 2>/dev/null | tail -n1 || echo 0)
if [ "${AVAIL_KB:-0}" -lt "$MIN_KB" ]; then echo "ERROR: insufficient disk space on /data ($AVAIL_KB KB)" > "$LOG_DIR/env-error.log" && exit 14; fi
# create non-root system user if missing
if ! id -u mongodev >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo useradd --system --user-group --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin mongodev; fi
sudo chown -R mongodev:mongodev /data/db
# choose log path: prefer container stdout if writable
if [ -w /proc/1/fd/1 ] 2>/dev/null; then LOG_PATH="/proc/1/fd/1"; else sudo touch "$LOG_DIR/mongod.log" && sudo chown mongodev:mongodev "$LOG_DIR/mongod.log" && LOG_PATH="$LOG_DIR/mongod.log"; fi
# backup system config if present
if [ -f /etc/mongod.conf ]; then sudo cp /etc/mongod.conf "/etc/mongod.conf.bak.$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"; fi

if (ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '(:|\*)27017') || (netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '(:|\*)27017'); then echo "ERROR: port 27017 in use; stop existing mongod or free port before running scripts" > "$LOG_DIR/env-error.log" && exit 13; fi
# write workspace-local mongod config (bootstrap: no auth)
cat > "$CONF_DIR/mongod.conf" <<EOF
storage:
  dbPath: /data/db
systemLog:
  destination: file
  path: ${LOG_PATH}
  logAppend: true
net:
  bindIp: 0.0.0.0
  port: 27017
processManagement:
  fork: false

sudo chmod 644 "$CONF_DIR/mongod.conf"

steps.name: scaffolding: generate lifecycle scripts (start/stop/bootstrap/restore/healthcheck)
steps.description: Generate workspace scripts: start-mongod (uses mongod --pidfilepath for robust pidfile creation and absolute mongod path), stop-mongod (validates PID ownership via /proc/<pid>/cmdline before shutdown/killing, supports admin shutdown via client), bootstrap-users (creates admin and dev users only when auth disabled), restore-sample (imports sample.json if present using resolved mongoimport), and healthcheck (container-friendly wrapper with timeout suitable for Docker HEALTHCHECK). Absolute binary paths are embedded by reading deps output to avoid PATH differences under sudo -u mongodev. Scripts document dev-only default credentials and accept env overrides.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/lms_dt3-307785-309186/LMSDatabase(MongoDB)"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"/scripts "$WORKSPACE"/data "$WORKSPACE"/logs
# discover absolute binaries from PATH (deps-03 will also record these)
MONGOD_BIN=$(command -v mongod || true)
MONGO_BIN=$(command -v mongo || true)
MONGOSH_BIN=$(command -v mongosh || true)
MONGOIMPORT_BIN=$(command -v mongoimport || true)
: > "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/_bins.env
echo "MONGOD_BIN=${MONGOD_BIN:-}" >> "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/_bins.env
echo "MONGO_BIN=${MONGO_BIN:-}" >> "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/_bins.env
echo "MONGOSH_BIN=${MONGOSH_BIN:-}" >> "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/_bins.env
echo "MONGOIMPORT_BIN=${MONGOIMPORT_BIN:-}" >> "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/_bins.env
chmod 600 "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/_bins.env || true
# start-mongod: use --pidfilepath for reliable pidfile
cat > "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/start-mongod.sh <<'BASH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="'"${WORKSPACE}"'"
source "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/_bins.env || true
CONFIG="$WORKSPACE/config/mongod.conf"
PIDFILE="$WORKSPACE/mongod.pid"
MONGOD="${MONGOD_BIN:-mongod}"
# if pidfile exists verify process is our mongod
if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$PID" ] && [ -d "/proc/$PID" ]; then CMD=$(tr -d '\0' < /proc/$PID/cmdline || true); if echo "$CMD" | grep -q "$(basename "$MONGOD")" && echo "$CMD" | grep -q "/data/db"; then echo already-running; exit 0; fi; fi; rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true; fi
# start mongod as mongodev writing pid to PIDFILE
if [ -z "$MONGOD_BIN" ]; then MONGOD="mongod"; fi
sudo -u mongodev "$MONGOD" --config "$CONFIG" --pidfilepath "$PIDFILE" &
# wait for pidfile
for i in {1..10}; do [ -f "$PIDFILE" ] && break || sleep 1; done
if [ ! -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then echo "ERROR: mongod failed to create pidfile" >&2; exit 21; fi
chown "$(id -un)":"$(id -gn)" "$PIDFILE" || true
BASH
chmod 750 "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/start-mongod.sh
# stop-mongod: validate pid matches mongod before shutdown
cat > "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/stop-mongod.sh <<'BASH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="'"${WORKSPACE}"'"
source "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/_bins.env || true
PIDFILE="$WORKSPACE/mongod.pid"
MONGO_BIN="${MONGO_BIN:-}"
MONGOSH_BIN="${MONGOSH_BIN:-}"
AUSER="${STOP_USER:-}"
APASS="${STOP_PASS:-}"
if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$PID" ] && [ -d "/proc/$PID" ]; then CMD=$(tr -d '\0' < /proc/$PID/cmdline || true); if echo "$CMD" | grep -q "mongod" && echo "$CMD" | grep -q "/data/db"; then
  # attempt client shutdown if client available
  if [ -n "$MONGO_BIN" ]; then
    if [ -n "$AUSER" ]; then echo 'db.getSiblingDB("admin").shutdownServer()' | "$MONGO_BIN" --username "$AUSER" --password "$APASS" --authenticationDatabase admin --quiet localhost:27017 || true
    else echo 'db.getSiblingDB("admin").shutdownServer()' | "$MONGO_BIN" --quiet localhost:27017 || true
    fi
  elif [ -n "$MONGOSH_BIN" ]; then
    if [ -n "$AUSER" ]; then "$MONGOSH_BIN" --quiet "mongodb://${AUSER}:${APASS}@localhost:27017/admin" --eval 'db.getSiblingDB("admin").shutdownServer()' || true
    else "$MONGOSH_BIN" --quiet "mongodb://localhost:27017" --eval 'db.getSiblingDB("admin").shutdownServer()' || true
    fi
  fi
  sleep 1 || true
  if [ -d "/proc/$PID" ]; then kill -TERM "$PID" || true; sleep 1 || true; fi
  fi; fi; rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true; fi
BASH
chmod 750 "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/stop-mongod.sh
# bootstrap-users: create admin and dev users only when auth disabled (dev-only defaults)
cat > "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/bootstrap-users.sh <<'BASH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="'"${WORKSPACE}"'"
source "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/_bins.env || true
CLIENT="${MONGO_BIN:-${MONGOSH_BIN:-}}"
ADMIN_USER="${ADMIN_USER:-admin}"
ADMIN_PASS="${ADMIN_PASS:-adminpass}"
DEV_USER="${DEV_USER:-devuser}"
DEV_PASS="${DEV_PASS:-devpass}"
# Development-only defaults; override via env. Only run if auth appears disabled.
if "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/healthcheck.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  JS="db.getSiblingDB('admin').createUser({user: '${ADMIN_USER}', pwd: '${ADMIN_PASS}', roles:[{role:'root', db:'admin'}]}); db.getSiblingDB('dev').createUser({user:'${DEV_USER}', pwd:'${DEV_PASS}', roles:[{role:'readWrite', db:'dev'}]});"
  if [ -n "${MONGO_BIN}" ]; then echo "$JS" | "${MONGO_BIN}" --quiet localhost:27017 || true
  else "${MONGOSH_BIN}" --quiet "mongodb://localhost:27017" --eval "$JS" || true
  fi
fi
BASH
chmod 750 "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/bootstrap-users.sh
# restore-sample: wait with timeout then mongoimport if present
cat > "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/restore-sample.sh <<'BASH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="'"${WORKSPACE}"'"
source "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/_bins.env || true
TIMEOUT=${RESTORE_TIMEOUT:-30}
for i in $(seq 1 $TIMEOUT); do "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/healthcheck.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && break || sleep 1; if [ "$i" -eq "$TIMEOUT" ]; then echo "restore-sample: mongod not ready"; exit 21; fi; done
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/data/sample.json" ]; then
  if [ -z "${MONGOIMPORT_BIN}" ]; then echo "mongoimport not found" > "$WORKSPACE"/logs/restore-error.log; exit 23; fi
  ${MONGOIMPORT_BIN} --db dev --collection items --jsonArray --file "$WORKSPACE/data/sample.json" --quiet || true
fi
BASH
chmod 750 "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/restore-sample.sh
# healthcheck: container-friendly with timeout; exit 0 healthy, non-zero unhealthy
cat > "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/healthcheck.sh <<'BASH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="'"${WORKSPACE}"'"
source "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/_bins.env || true
TIMEOUT=${HEALTH_TIMEOUT:-10}
USER="${HEALTH_USER:-}"
PASS="${HEALTH_PASS:-}"
if [ -n "${MONGO_BIN}" ]; then CMD="$MONGO_BIN --quiet"
else CMD="${MONGOSH_BIN:-mongosh} --quiet"
fi
for i in $(seq 1 $TIMEOUT); do
  if [ -n "$USER" ] && [ -n "${MONGO_BIN}" ]; then $MONGO_BIN --username "$USER" --password "$PASS" --authenticationDatabase admin --eval "db.runCommand({ping:1})" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0 || :; fi
  if [ -n "$USER" ] && [ -n "${MONGOSH_BIN}" ]; then $MONGOSH_BIN --quiet "mongodb://${USER}:${PASS}@localhost:27017/admin" --eval "db.runCommand({ping:1})" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0 || :; fi
  if [ -z "$USER" ] && [ -n "${MONGO_BIN}" ]; then $MONGO_BIN --eval "db.runCommand({ping:1})" --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0 || :; fi
  if [ -z "$USER" ] && [ -n "${MONGOSH_BIN}" ]; then $MONGOSH_BIN --quiet "mongodb://localhost:27017" --eval "db.runCommand({ping:1})" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0 || :; fi
  sleep 1
done
exit 2
BASH
chmod 750 "$WORKSPACE"/scripts/healthcheck.sh
chown -R "$(id -un)":"$(id -gn)" "$WORKSPACE"/scripts "$WORKSPACE"/data "$WORKSPACE"/logs || true
exit 0

Healthcheck and restore scripts now pass credentials correctly (mongosh: connection string; mongo: flags) and check for mongoimport. deps-03 expanded checks to include timeout and mongoimport and records versions. validation-05 now backs up workspace config prior to enabling auth and uses append-safe edits; restart sequence uses pidfile and waits for readiness. Ensured generated files are owned with safe permissions and that scripts are idempotent. These changes fix PID handling, client differences, auth-aware healthchecks, service conflicts on port 27017, and ownership/permission races.

Refined steps to address analyst feedback: env-01 (added disk free-space check, /proc/1/fd/1 writability check with fallback to workspace log, clarified best-effort system mongod stop and explicit abort guidance); scaffold-02 (replaced fragile $! pid approach with mongod --pidfilepath, fixed malformed pid checks, embed absolute binary paths discovered by deps-03, validate pid ownership via /proc/<pid>/cmdline, enforce timeouts in healthcheck, note dev-only default creds); deps-03 (resolve absolute binary paths for mongod, mongo/mongosh, mongoimport, record versions and check executability by mongodev); test-04 (increase configurable readiness timeout, add listening verification for 0.0.0.0:27017 and avoid swallowing bootstrap/restore failures); validation-05 (create temporary merged config and run mongod --configCheck where available before enabling auth to avoid YAML corruption, and ensure safe idempotent edits). These changes fix critical pidfile races, ensure binaries are resolved absolutely, add disk and log-path validation, harden stop/start, and provide an orchestrator-ready healthcheck. All modifications preserve original step IDs and flow.
